observed: The stored DrawUpToEffect target remained EffectTarget.TargetController instead of SpecificEntity(victim).
At the next upkeep no victim 0..2 draw decision was produced after the target spell had left the stack.

diagnosis.cause: CreateDelayedTriggerExecutor recursively bakes several context-dependent effect targets but has no DrawUpToEffect arm; TargetController requires state-aware resolution while the target spell is still on the stack.

successor: Add the narrow scheduling-time bake for DrawUpToEffect player targets using state-aware resolution, pin that shared executor in the workflow, and rerun the exact six predeclared mechanics cases with historical card/test bytes unchanged.
